insights.one_liner: Inverto is BCG's procurement and supply chain consultancy, 700+ experts worldwide, with an English-friendly entry-level role in Amsterdam.

culture.text: A consultancy specialised in strategic procurement and supply chain management, operating under BCG.
More than 700 experts across three continents, with offices including Amsterdam, Berlin, London, Paris and Shanghai; headquartered in Cologne.
Staff often studied business or supply chain at Cologne, Copenhagen Business School, Bocconi, Nova or Mannheim.
